name: Extra-Truncated-Cube Contraction Obstructions
definition: $\mathcal V_d=\mathcal T_d\setminus\{[d]\setminus\{1,2\}\}$: start with all subsets of $[d]$ of size at most $d-2$ and delete one additional maximal state.
parameters: $d\ge4$. It has $2^d-d-2$ states and isometric dimension $d$.
canonical_form: All choices of the additional deleted $(d-2)$-set are equivalent under coordinate permutations.
recognition: The family is a downset with one maximal state removed from $\mathcal T_d$. Each coordinate contraction is a cube with either one vertex or two adjacent vertices deleted.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. The graph $\mathcal V_4$ is one of the three dimension-four closed-orientable antipodal nonlearning graphs.
